title: tc-agent-face
description: Donovan's animated face, which shows what the agent is doing.

state.description: idle · listening · thinking · speaking · happy · confused · sleeping · error · surprised

size.description: Width and height in px, 16 to 256

label.description: Replaces the screen-reader label in every state

labels.description: Screen-reader labels per state, for translation

announce.description: Also tells screen readers when the state changes

motion.description: full or reduced; unset, it follows the system setting

restAfter.description: How long, in ms, before the small movements fade out when Donovan isn't busy

amplitude.description: How loud the agent is, 0 to 1, to drive the mouth while speaking; unset, it makes up speech
